what: Empty uptime cube renders as a perfect 100% fleet score
note: uptimePct() returns 100 when window<=0; a month with no summary rows is indistinguishable from a flawless month. The 6-month trend fan-out (api/reports.ts:63) plots 100% for every un-aggregated month. This is the contractual 98% SLA number.

what: Monthly report cubes never cover the month the screens ask for
note: previousUtcMonthStart means cron only ever writes LAST month. Controller/service defaults are the CURRENT month (reports.controller.ts:117, reports.service.ts:389/440). Fleet Uptime, Root Cause and ZM Scorecard all default to a month no cron populates; only a manual POST /recompute fills it.

what: No report says when its number was computed
note: CONTEXT requires a data-as-of stamp on every manager dashboard. ReportsPage stamps new Date() at fetch (ReportsPage.tsx:73) — fetch time, not data time. The global SnapshotBanner shows telemetry-ingest freshness and reads green while a cube is a month stale. Exports already does this right (exports.controller.ts:22 dataAsOf).

GET /reports/fleet-uptime (default month) -> {"month":"2026-09-01","fleet":{"eligibleDeviceCount":0,"autoRecoveryClosures":0,"seRepairedClosures":0,"uptimePct":100},"rows":[]}. Zero devices, zero closures, no rows, and a perfect score. ?month=2026-07 on the same endpoint returns eligibleDeviceCount 15311 and uptimePct 56.19 with five real zone rows. The one real month is 41.81pp BELOW the 98% target; the fabricated current month is 2pp above it. Same for 2026-08 (the month cron is supposed to write): 0 devices, uptimePct 100. Identical 100/0-rows for 2026-05, 2026-04, 2026-03. Fabrication repeats per month in the 6-month trend fan-out.

what: No report says when its number was computed
note: REPRODUCED by scanning four live JSON bodies for any freshness key. fleet-uptime, root-cause, efficiency and zm-scorecard: NO computedAt / generatedAt / dataAsOf / asOf field in any of them. GET /exports/entity-mapping/summary in the SAME app returns {"rowCount":30381,"dataAsOf":"2026-09-01T12:01:32.999Z"}. The stamp is not merely absent, it is DISCARDED: device_downtime_summary_monthly.computed_at exists on the table (schema.prisma:2682, NOT NULL timestamptz) and the report projection drops it. Adding it is a select-list change, not a schema change.

note: NOT A GAP - record as a green. Cross-zone-joining surface re-checked per shared-primer instruction.
